findings.symptom: The displayed title is all lowercase (“regular local hilbert samuel multiplicity one”), unlike conventional title casing and the mathematical style used elsewhere.
findings.suggested_repair: Use a readable title such as “Regular local Hilbert–Samuel multiplicity is one”.

findings.symptom: The displayed title is all lowercase (“embedding dimension and regular local ring”).
findings.suggested_repair: Capitalize the title consistently, e.g. “Embedding dimension and regular local rings”.

findings.symptom: The displayed title is all lowercase (“local global dimension equals residue field projective dimension”).
findings.suggested_repair: Capitalize the title consistently, e.g. “Local global dimension equals residue-field projective dimension”.

findings.symptom: The displayed title spells the standard Serre-condition notation in words (“r one s two intersection of height one localisations”), which is difficult to scan as a mathematical title.
findings.suggested_repair: Use a title that retains the conventional notation, e.g. “The intersection of height-one localizations under (R₁) and (S₂)”.

findings.symptom: The long inline rendering of the first-nonzero-Ext degree formula reaches the right edge with the relation ending at “<”; its final “∞” appears at the start of the next line, visually separating the relation from its operand. The statement beginning “Let R be Noetherian” and the full “Given:” label are present in the standalone original PNG.
findings.suggested_repair: Break the formula at a deliberate point or use a displayed/aligned equation so “< ∞” remains together.
